sources.quote: 使用電源 専用ACアダプタ DC10V 850mA
使用電源 専用ACアダプタ DC10V 850mA

sources.method: 850 mA ÷ 1000 = 0.85 A, from Nintendo Japan's Famicom hardware page '専用ACアダプタ DC10V 850mA' (https://www.nintendo.com/jp/famicom/hardware/index.html).

notes: Nintendo Japan's Famicom hardware page (text 'based on the manual of the time'): the console runs from its dedicated AC adapter at DC10V 850mA, and the adapter HVC-002 is an included accessory. The rating is the console's supply line, which names the dedicated adapter; the adapter's own label is not quoted. Envelope, mass, cord and plug: null (measurement queue). This is NOT the NES adapter NES-002, which is a different (AC-output) unit with no Nintendo source found.
